method_notes: Benchmark is VOO buy-and-hold through the same backtest engine.
All active variants start by buying VOO, then go to cash on HMM high-volatility stress, and re-enter VOO when the policy's calm condition is confirmed.
Signals are generated after a bar closes and execute at the next bar open, matching the existing single-symbol backtest engine.
HMM observation buckets are calibrated only from historical bars available at that point in the walk-forward timeline.
The HMM state is high-volatility stress, not a pure bearish-direction classifier.
No explicit transaction-cost or slippage model is added by this research runner.

policy.name: regime_1_1
policy.description: Exit after one High Vol Stress regime print; re-enter after one non-stress print.

policy.name: regime_2_3
policy.description: Exit after two consecutive High Vol Stress prints; re-enter after three consecutive non-stress prints.

policy.name: prob55_40_2_3
policy.description: Exit after high-stress posterior >= 55% for two bars; re-enter below 40% and non-stress for three bars.

policy.name: prob45_30_2_3
policy.description: Exit after high-stress posterior >= 45% for two bars; re-enter below 30% and non-stress for three bars.

policy.name: lowvol_reentry_2_3
policy.description: Exit after high-stress posterior >= 55% for two bars; re-enter only after three Low Vol Trend bars.

policy.name: regime_sma200_1_3
policy.description: Exit after one High Vol Stress print only when price is below its 200-day SMA; re-enter after three non-stress bars above the 200-day SMA.

policy.name: prob55_sma200_2_3
policy.description: Exit after high-stress posterior >= 55% for two bars only when price is below its 200-day SMA; re-enter below 40% and above the 200-day SMA for three bars.

policy.name: prob55_trend50_2_3
policy.description: Exit after high-stress posterior >= 55% for two bars only when the trailing 50-day return is negative; re-enter below 40% and positive 50-day return for three bars.
